notes.title: New Update Version 1.7
notes.content:
This update further improves the gaming experience, thanks to the resolution of bugs such as: jumping with boxes and "jumping into the void".

We recommend joining our [url=https://discord.gg/jKYmfpBcc2]Discord server[/url] to learn more about future updates!
